cases.expected_answer: No relaxation for years of experience and turnover is granted to MSEs in this field.

cases.expected_answer: It must meet the quality and technical specifications and upload supporting documents proving eligibility for relaxation.

cases.expected_answer: 2500 km per month and 36 months of deployment.

cases.question: Across all three consignee tables, how many vehicles are required and what is the group split?
cases.expected_answer: 6 vehicles: 1 Scorpio or equivalent, 3 Boleros in the second group, and 2 Boleros in the third group.

cases.question: Does the No entry for MSE experience and turnover relaxation rule out an MSE service provider claiming EMD exemption?
cases.expected_answer: No. The relaxation field says No, but an MSE service provider may seek EMD exemption with valid category documents; traders are excluded.

cases.question: Who pays the diesel running cost first, how is it reimbursed, and what standard bill-payment timeline is stated?
cases.expected_answer: The contractor pays first. CCL reimburses diesel with the monthly bill. Payment is within 21 days of the service acceptance certificate and online bill submission.

cases.question: What do the ePBG field and buyer-added ATC separately say about performance security?
cases.expected_answer: ePBG Required says No. The ATC says performance security and additional performance security, as applicable, must be deposited as per the award of work.
